title: Serverless Topology Rules
description: Architectural rules for the serverless execution topology.

rules.title: Network Security Profile
rules.description: Serverless components MUST define a 'networkSecurity' profile in their config.

rules.title: mTLS Enforcement
rules.description: mTLS must be enabled for all serverless network communications.

rules.title: Declared Serverless Contract
rules.description: A Serverless satellite MUST provide serverless.config.json.

rules.title: Bounded Deployment Package
rules.description: serverless.config.json MUST declare a positive package.maxSizeMb not exceeding 50.

rules.title: Cold-Start Readiness
rules.description: serverless.config.json MUST declare positive coldStart.maxInitMilliseconds and coldStart.lazyInitialization=true.
